Name: Capture Base
Details:
Your objective is to enter a target facility, clear out any enemy presence, and occupy the facility for a number of rounds. The base may have long-range fixed defenses in the form of turrets, and there may be additional enemy units that will attempt to retake the base. Armor and sufficient ammunition are recommended.

Expected Forces: <color=#F8A194>4–12 'Mechs</color>
